chunks: Then al-Ḥārith said: In that case, I shall withdraw along with Sa‘d ibn Mālik and ‘Abdullāh ibn ‘Umar;
ai.seo_question: Who did al-Harith choose to withdraw with in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Al-Harith’s declaration of withdrawal (i'tizal) alongside Sa'd ibn Malik and Abdullah ibn Umar reflects the early Shia concept of political quietism and distancing from unjust rulers to preserve religious integrity. This stance is historically significant as it aligns with the Ahl al-Bayt's strategy of avoiding premature conflict while maintaining moral authority during periods of political turmoil. The reference to these specific companions highlights a shared consensus on discerning truth from falsehood in leadership matters.
